  - What it is: an animated episode that is a prologue to the Final Fantasy XV: Episode Ardyn game (a story DLC)
    - it gives the background of Ardyn and "details his life 2,000 years ago when he worked as a healer" (the user, 2026-10-17: this sets it chronologically, which the entry's order values already do)
    - **the audio is in Japanese, English subtitles are available, and it can be watched for free on YouTube (user, 2026-10-17: the entry should have the `Free` tag and link directly to the official YouTube video; the `Free` tag was added, and the platform row already links the official video, https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8yOOF8AKQbw)**
  - Plot (large recap): the Caelum brothers Ardyn, a healer, and Somnus, a warrior, the Starscourge and the daemons, the Oracle Aera, the choice of the Chosen King, and Ardyn's fate
    - agrees with the entry's description (Ardyn Izunia's background 2,000 years ago when he worked as a healer)
    - the details and the ending are spoilers and not copied
  - Development: made after a fan survey asked for more about Ardyn, when Episode Ignis was meant to be the last DLC, as a thank-you and a kind of promotion
    - developed by Satellite Inc. with the main story and design by the Final Fantasy XV team, directed by Shinichi Kurita
